Select activity details for the parent compound CHEMBL95 and all its salts against target CHEMBL220. Define the compound set by joining molecule_hierarchy from the parent molregno to include all related forms. Retrieve activity provenance using the FAQ path: molecule_dictionary -> compound_records -> docs -> activities -> assays -> target_dictionary. Include canonical_smiles via LEFT JOIN compound_structures. Filter for IC50 bioactivities with standard_units equal to nM and target CHEMBL220. Return compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism. Do not limit the number of rows.
